Mobject

Source: R/mobject.R, R/zz_constructors.R
MobjectClass.Rd

Base class for mathematical objects. Most users construct subclasses such as Circle() or VGroup(). All transformation methods modify the object in place and return it invisibly, so calls chain: Square()$shift(LEFT)$scale(2).

Usage

Mobject(color = "#FFFFFF", name = NULL, z_index = 0, ...)

Arguments

color

Color of the mobject.

name

Name; the class name by default.

z_index

Drawing order: higher values are drawn on top.

...

Fields of the class to set, such as those set_default() gives; any other name is an error.

Details

Fields: points (n x 3 matrix), submobjects (list), z_index, updaters, name. Active bindings width, height, depth get or set the size. The active binding animate records method calls as an animation, as in scene$play(sq$animate$shift(RIGHT)$scale(2)).
